name: Axiom
summary: Axiom stores logs, traces and events in datasets with a retention period set per dataset. The Personal plan is $0 with 500 GB of monthly loading, 25 GB of storage and 30-day retention. Axiom Cloud costs $25 a month plus usage, with 1 TB of loading and 100 GB of storage included.

facts.text: Retention is set per dataset, and shortening it permanently deletes older data. On Axiom Cloud a dataset can keep data longer than the organization default or forever.
Monitors come in three types: threshold, match and anomaly. Notifiers include email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Discord and custom webhooks.
SAML single sign-on is a $100 a month add-on on Axiom Cloud and is not available on the Personal plan.
The Personal plan has no overage option, so usage is capped at the included amounts.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: 500 GB of data loading and 10 GB-hours of query compute a month, 25 GB storage, 30-day retention, alerting included, community support

plans.name: Axiom Cloud
plans.notes: Platform fee plus usage. Includes 1 TB of loading, 100 GB-hours of query compute and 100 GB storage a month, configurable retention

hiddenCosts: Loading above the allowance costs $0.12 per GB in the first tier, query compute $0.20 per GB-hour and frequently accessed storage $0.03 per GB a month.
SAML single sign-on costs $100 a month, Directory Sync $100, RBAC $50 and Extended Audit Logs $50.
Support beyond email, including an SLA, is sold as an add-on.
